text: __NOTOC__ Grezz Ragefist is an orc warrior trainer located on the second floor of the Barracks in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. Before Shadowlands, he was on the first floor of the Hall of the Brave. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with an Orgrimmar Grunt.

Gri'lek's Charm of Might is a trinket created with the Punctured Voodoo Doll (warrior). This item can be acquired through crafting or another combine-type effect.

Grelin Whitebeard is a dwarf quest giver located in Whitebeard's Encampment within the Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. He is accompanied by an absent-minded apprentice and a lost gnome. Jona Ironstock and Grelin are good friends.

Gretchen Dedmar is a Forsaken quest giver formerly located inside Gallows' End Tavern in Brill but now residing at Death's Watch Waystation. Based on the text of the quest she starts, it sounds as if she is about to become a mindless zombie.

Grik'nir the Cold is an ice troll mob found in the Frostmane Hovel at the southern end of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. He leads the Frostmane tribe within the Hovel, and he is planning to use a fire elemental to take Coldridge Valley from the dwarves. In the past, he stole Grelin Whitebeard's Journal.
Gri'lek's Blood is combined with other unique items to form a special class trinket.
__NOTOC__ Greta Mosshoof is a tauren quest giver located at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood. She is affiliated with the Emerald Circle. She is friends with Islen Waterseer.
Gri'lek's Charm of Valor is created with the Punctured Voodoo Doll (paladin).

Grellkin can be found at the abandoned furbolg camps and throughout the forest in Shadowglen on Teldrassil. After being corrupted by Fel Moss, the grell and grellkin moved into Shadowglen and infested the area, posing a threat to its residents. They also took a liking to the mushrooms in Shadowglen. Despite the blessing of Teldrassil by two of the Dragon Aspects shortly before the Cataclysm, the grellkin continued to be tainted by the Fel Moss. It was later discovered that there was one last source of corruption on Teldrassil: the Bough of Corruption. With its destruction, the grellkin may finally have been freed from the moss's influence.
Grilled Mudfish is created by Outland Cooking (20); taught by Recipe: Grilled Mudfish.
__NOTOC__ Gri'lek's Carver is a two-handed axe that is highly destructive to Dragonkin. The high-end damage means this axe is nice for Mortal Striking warriors.

Grim Ulang is a trading village. This Horde outpost was established in Azshara to compete with the goblin merchants. It offers goods and weapons for everyone, from dwarven explorers to high elves who are hunting the undead. Steady rumors and sightings have led to frequent night elf patrols and an increased martial presence in Grim Ulang.

The Grim Guzzler Key is a key that is carried by Plugger Spazzring, the bartender of Grim Guzzler in Blackrock Depths. This key opens the rear door of Grim Guzzler. This allows access to the deeper areas of Blackrock Depths.

Grim Thunderbrews eyes glitter beneath his heavy brow. His massive waraxe rests easily in his large, capable hands, an equally impressive battle hammer at his side; gems encrust his silvery armor and dwarven runes are carved about his elaborate battle horn. He looks like a war god come to life. Grim is a fearless warrior. He charges into battle, axe held high, targeting the largest foe available. He is no fool, however, and places any allies and troops to his best advantage. He will even retreat when necessary, though he likes to act as if he does not know the meaning of the word, and often uses the image of a raging barbarian to trick his opponents into underestimating him. Grezzix Spindlesnap is a goblin self-styled Master of Disguise near Kamagua in Howling Fjord. He seems to form a group with "Tiny" Jimb, Lou the Cabin Boy and his parrot Molly. When he saw the cursed items looted from that graveyard, he brought Lou and himself out to Kamagua, the nearby tuskarr village. (See .) He is a pirate and a mercenary.

Later, when Rom's group of warriors and Vereesa Windrunner tried to hold of an attack by fire elementals, a hole appeared and some of the dwarven warriors fell down (including Rom). Grex Brainboiler is a goblin vendor found in Area 52 in the Netherstorm. He sells vintage Level 60 PvP cloth and leather armor. In order to purchase from him you must have the appropriate Legacy achievement from the old PvP ranking system (eg: Legionnaire (Legacy); Knight-Captain (Legacy)).

Grennan Stormspeaker is a Tauren Shaman. He was one of the Horde heroes in the first series of the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game. He once fought Onyxia. Quotes from him and references to him can be found on the following cards: *"The wood whispered to me as I conjured it. It said it did not fear flame." - Searing Totem *“As our ancestors watch over us in our passing, so too will they aid in our return from the spirit realm.” - Call the Spirit *Grennan's ties with nature made him comfortable in any environment... until he found himself among dozens of smoking, shaking dragon eggs. - Feeding Time *"May the spirits guide us to the unseen wisdom that was lost an eternity ago." - Spaulders
Grezla the Hag is a human located near the Eventide in Dalaran. She can provide directions to various locations in Dalaran.

The Greymist tribe is a tribe of murlocs found around Mist's Edge in Darkshore. They may be led by Murkdeep. Murkdeep is wanted by the Auberdine Village Council for the death of at least one Sentinel and the sinking of at least two cargo vessels in the waters off Darkshore.
__NOTOC__ Gremnik Rizzlesprang is a goblin ghost found in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

.]] Greymane Manor is a palatial estate high in the hills of western Gilneas, owned by Genn Greymane and his family. The manor was considered something of a safe bastion as Gilneas begun to crumble and collapse under the effects of the Cataclysm and the ongoing Forsaken invasion. However, it was later abandoned as it was still vulnerable to Forsaken attacks. It currently remains empty.

Grim Visage is a Horde-only reputation and experience gain bonus that is available only during the Hallow's End seasonal event. To acquire the buff, a player uses the bonfire in front of the Wickerman in the Ruins of Lordaeron, then uses the Wickerman Ashes that are created. A Time to Build Up instructs players to perform this procedure, but it is not required for the buff. The buff can be obtained as many times as desired at any time during the holiday. It does not persist through death.

Grinding is the act of doing something repetitively, such as killing monsters or working up a trade skill. If one is grinding their levels, it usually refers to killing massive amounts of creeps. If one is grinding for reputation, they may be collecting items for repeatable quests for a particular faction. In older MMORPGs, such as EverQuest, grinding was the primary way to advance your character's level. The quest system was very underdeveloped, as opposed to the quest system in World of Warcraft. Grimestack is a goblin stable master located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He stands just outside The Salty Sailor Tavern.

Grime-Encrusted Object drops from most humanoids in Gnomeregan. At first sight, these appear to be vendor trash. Essentially they are until you reach the Sparklematic 5200 (also located in Gnomeregan) which allows you to wash the items. If you do not wash them, you can sell them to a vendor for each. These can also be bought from Barkeep Hann in Duskwood, in limited supply, for . Washing these items using the Sparklematic 5200 will award a Sparklematic-Wrapped Box.

Grimnur Stonebrand is a dwarf fishing trainer and quest giver located at the entrance to the shop Traveling Fisherman in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge. The Grimtotem Spirit Wolf, previously known as Grimtotem Spirit Guide, is a mob which was introduced in patch 2.3. It is summoned by Grimtotem Spirit-Shifters in Dustwallow Marsh.

Griniblix the Spectator is a goblin in a black tunic. He does as his name implies, he watches the battles between the players and the rare spawns: Skarr the Unbreakable, The Razza or Mushgog in the central Dire Maul arena in Feralas. He yells as well if any of the other rare spawns have spawned and can be heard in any part of Dire Maul.
Grips of Sculptured Icicles drop from Commander Stoutbeard and Commander Kolurg in the Nexus.
This item is a reward from the quest Into the Breach (Grizzly Hills)
Grindle Firespark is a level 80 gnome located in Dalaran. He can provide directions to various locations found within Dalaran.

The Grimscale tribe is a tribe of murlocs found on both the Golden Strand and Tranquil Shore in the Eversong Woods. They are led by Mmmrrrggglll. They are involved in a few quests. Interestingly, there are some undead former Grimscales in the Ghostlands. They are involved in the quest The Plagued Coast in which it is said that, like the Forsaken, "they've retained free will in undeath" also.
Grimkor the Wicked is an elite necromancer located at the Ironwall Rampart in Icecrown. Thassarian and Koltira Deathweaver ask adventurers to summon Grimkor with the Rune of Distortion and kill him.
Grimy Grub Guts is a quest item for Getting Your Hands Dirty (quest).
Grips of Arcane Imprisonment is a quest reward from Through the Dream.

Grimy Greasefingers is one of two innkeepers standing across from each other at the central building within Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara, the other innkeeper being Mixi. He can also be found as an innkeeper at various locations within the Lost Isles.
Grimmr Hounds are plague-dogs who spawn in the Underhalls in Icecrown during The Sum is Greater than the Parts.
